source.check: Returned unopposed (nominations, Belfast News-Letter, 27 April 1939). Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of Fermanagh County Council, polled Wednesday 31 May 1939 (Belfast News-Letter, 1 June 1939: the only contest 'took place yesterday in Enniskillen'). One contest, in Enniskillen; all other divisions were uncontested. The nominations list of 27 April 1939 names the unopposed candidates. The Herald of 29 April 1939 names the Nationalist members, including James M'Mahon for Rosslea, completing the twenty divisions. Structure and division names for the 1966-67 amalgamation are in notes/fermanagh-fcra-1969.md, from Fermanagh CRA, 'Fermanagh Facts' (1969). That is an advocacy pamphlet: use it for names only, not figures. Its register figures are disputed by Kingsley (2021) on the Omagh Rural District scheme. Read the page image before recording any number from it. Returned unopposed.
